Reverie v1.0.0 launch plan (post-codexCLI rebrand). Decided 2026-05-06.

PHASE 1 STATUS (2026-05-06): COMPLETE.
  - Domain/trademark clearance: see project.identity NAME-CLEARANCE. Decision: skip premium domain, use seabear.dev/reverie, no own-mark filing.
  - Bun runtime validate: PASS (gate met). See project.bunValidate. Recommended commit-phase shape: Option A (Node-test / Bun-production split — keep vitest under Node, ship binaries via `bun build --compile`).

PHASE 3 STATUS (2026-05-06): SURFACE REBRAND COMPLETE. Shipped as v1.0.0-beta.0 (00f4da6, tag 2026-05-06).
  - Internal rebrand (code/tests/CI/docs): swept all in-source/in-test/in-CI/in-doc refs for binary/package/repo/tap names
  - External rename (user-driven): seabearDEV/codexCLI → seabearDEV/reverie, homebrew-ccli → homebrew-reverie. Both done.
  - Decisions locked: rvr-dev/rvr-dev-mcp dev binaries; back-compat shim DROPPED; CCLI_PASSWORD → RVR_PASSWORD; CCLI_PAGER → RVR_PAGER (caught in 3e68d0b residue sweep)
  - Phase 3 deliberately PRESERVED codex_* tools, .codexcli/, "the codex" noun, $codexcli envelope, all CODEX_* env vars under "load-bearing data-layer naming" rationale. THIS DECISION HAS BEEN REVERSED — see Phase 3.5.

PHASE 3.5 STATUS (2026-05-06): SPEC LOCKED. Deep rebrand of preserved data-layer surfaces. Targets v1.0.0-beta.1.
  - Spec doc: docs/design-rebrand-deep.md (D1-D6 decisions locked, full migration algorithm, test plan, 15-step impl order)
  - Surfaces affected: directory (.codexcli/ → .reverie/, with auto-migration), envelope ($codexcli → $reverie with back-compat read), env vars (CODEX_* → RVR_*, hard cutover), MCP tools (codex_* → reverie_*, hard cutover, no shim), noun ("the codex" → "Reverie" used as a system name)
  - Dirname `.reverie/` cleared: see project.identity DIRNAME CLEARANCE
  - Implementation NOT started. Step 1 (lock spec) and step 2 (verify dirname uncontested) complete; step 3+ pending fresh session
  - Phase 2 (Bun commit-phase + short-flag audit) becomes v1.0.0-beta.2 after deep rebrand soak

V1.0.0 vs V2.0.0 DECISION:
Chose v1.0.0 (new product launch) over v2.0.0 (codexCLI continuation) because: (1) the product is genuinely different from v1.0 codexCLI ("CLI for dot-notation datastore" → "bicameral memory layer for AI-assisted dev"); (2) marketing — "introducing Reverie" beats "codexCLI v2"; (3) git history continues (rename, not fork) so dogfooding case studies preserved; (4) clean SEO/search reset. SemVer-wise: this is essentially a re-baseline — Reverie has never had a v1.0, codexCLI's history is honored via renamed repo + CHANGELOG provenance section.

WORKSTREAMS:

1. TECHNICAL FOUNDATION
   - Bun migration: validate phase (½ day) → commit phase (1-2d). Verify MCP SDK works. Test suite passing.  [VALIDATE PASSED 2026-05-06; commit-phase recommended Option A — see project.bunValidate]
   - Short-flag audit (see context.shortFlagAudit) — holistic flag namespace reorg
   - Release pipeline updated (Bun --compile cross-target binaries)

2. SURFACE REBRAND  [COMPLETE 2026-05-06, v1.0.0-beta.0]
   - Repo rename seabearDEV/codexCLI → seabearDEV/reverie  [DONE — auto-redirects active]
   - Brew tap rename homebrew-ccli → homebrew-reverie  [DONE]
   - Package name codexcli → @seabear/reverie  [DONE]
   - Binary rename ccli → rvr (cclid → rvr-dev for dev)  [DONE]
   - MCP server identifier in client config: codexcli → reverie  [DONE]
   - CHANGELOG narrative: "Previously known as codexCLI" provenance section  [DONE]
   - Documentation overhaul  [DONE]
   - Env vars CCLI_PASSWORD → RVR_PASSWORD, CCLI_PAGER → RVR_PAGER  [DONE — breaking, captured in CHANGELOG]
   - Back-compat shim `ccli completions` DROPPED  [DONE — fresh launch decision]

2.5 DEEP REBRAND  [SPEC LOCKED 2026-05-06; targets v1.0.0-beta.1]
   - Project + global store directories: .codexcli/ → .reverie/ (atomic-rename auto-migration on first access)
   - Export envelope key: $codexcli → $reverie (back-compat read kept, write-side hard cut)
   - Env vars: CODEX_* → RVR_* (hard cutover, all 7)
   - MCP tools: codex_* → reverie_* (hard cutover, all 19, no shim)
   - Prose noun: "the codex" → "Reverie" used as a system name
   - Spec: docs/design-rebrand-deep.md
   - Soaks before v1.0.0 stable

3. BRANDING / VISUAL
   - Logo/wordmark, color palette (shadow/dream/consciousness register)
   - Light Westworld-inspired touches without being heavy-handed
   - Marketing site at seabear.dev/reverie

4. DOMAIN / LEGAL
   - Domain check: reverie.dev, reverie.ai  [DONE 2026-05-06 — see project.identity NAME-CLEARANCE]
   - USPTO trademark search (Class 9 + 42, ~10 min DIY)  [DONE 2026-05-06 — see project.identity NAME-CLEARANCE]
   - Trademark filing if pursuing  [DECIDED: not filing own mark for v1.0.0]

5. COMMERCIAL LAUNCH (see project.commercialContext)
   - SeaBear Studios product page
   - Consulting tier/pricing structure
   - Inquiry response template
   - "Reverie for Teams" landing draft

6. MIGRATION FOR EXISTING USERS
   - Migration guide  [PARTIAL — CHANGELOG covers binary/package/env-var rename; deep-rebrand auto-migration covered by Phase 2.5 design doc]
   - .codexcli/ on-disk data: auto-migrates to .reverie/ on first access under v1.0.0-beta.1+
   - GitHub auto-redirect handles repo URL transition  [LIVE]

7. LAUNCH ANNOUNCEMENT
   - Blog post: bicameral story + "codexCLI is now Reverie"
   - Dogfooding Part Three (deferred from v1.14, naturally pairs with rebrand)
   - GitHub inbound outreach
   - HN/Reddit/etc. optional depending on traction strategy

PHASING (rough):
- Phase 1 (3-5d): Pre-flight — domain/trademark/Bun validate  [COMPLETE 2026-05-06]
- Phase 2 (10-14d): Technical foundation (Bun commit-phase, short-flag audit)  [TARGETS v1.0.0-beta.2]
- Phase 2.5 (5-7d): Deep rebrand — directory, envelope, env vars, MCP tools, noun  [SPEC LOCKED 2026-05-06; TARGETS v1.0.0-beta.1]
- Phase 3 (5-7d): Surface rebrand sweep  [COMPLETE 2026-05-06]
- Phase 4 (3-5d): Commercial infrastructure
- Phase 5: Launch

RELEASE SEQUENCE (revised 2026-05-06):
- v1.0.0-beta.0  [SHIPPED 2026-05-06] — surface rebrand
- v1.0.0-beta.1  [NEXT] — deep rebrand (Phase 2.5)
- v1.0.0-beta.2  — Phase 2 (Bun commit-phase, short-flag audit)
- v1.0.0  — stable

REALISTIC TIMELINE: 8-12 weeks evenings/weekends.

DEFERRED TO v1.1+:
- Web app / visualization layer (mindmap, topology) — natural pairing with #83
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation (carried from v1.15 hints)
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators — user pre-flagged in project.v115Hints)
- Entry health / staleness work (#84)
- `rvr migrate-claude-md` command for mass-updating CLAUDE.md across dogfooded projects (out of scope for v1.0.0-beta.1, deferrable post-launch if needed)

SUPERSEDES: project.v114Plan and project.v115Hints (those remain as historical record). Future cycle planning happens under this entry.
